integrity: The proof derives the Hermitian LCD condition from a two-dimensional Cauchy--Binet determinant and constructs an explicit inverse pair of parity updates on projective-column multiplicities. A standalone exact verifier reconstructs \(\operatorname{PG}(1,4)\), its projective linear action, all parity cases, and complete multiplicity-orbit bijections for even lengths through \(20\).
scientific_limitations: The result resolves only the first, dimension-two identity posed in the source. It concerns the source's standard monomial-equivalence classes and does not address the accompanying dimension-three identity.
title: An involution proves the even-length dimension-two Hermitian LCD count identity
